test_cases.name: basic_carousel_request
test_cases.input: Transform this image into 20 vertical slices for an X carousel post
assertions: Runs slice_carousel.py on the provided image
Produces x_carousel_slices.zip containing part_01.jpg through part_20.jpg
Delivers the ZIP to the user with render_file

test_cases.name: portuguese_request
test_cases.input: Transforme a imagem anexada no formato de carrossel vertical de 20 fatias para o X
assertions: Recognizes the request and activates the skill
Generates exactly 20 slices named part_01.jpg to part_20.jpg

test_cases.name: with_preview_explicit
test_cases.input: Slice my image into 20 parts for Twitter carousel and also give me a preview
assertions: ZIP contains both the 20 slices and the preview image

test_cases.name: odd_width_handling
test_cases.input: Make a 20-slice carousel from this 1920x1080 image
assertions: Distributes remainder pixels so all 20 slices cover the full width with no gaps
